Trace, implement and test: Two Distinct Even

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
// C++ code to implement above approach
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

// Divide number into 2 even parts
bool divNum(int n)
{
	return (n <= 2
				? false
				: (n % 2 == 0
					? true
					: false));
}

// Driven Program
int main()
{
	int n = 8;
	cout << (divNum(n) ? "YES" : "NO")
		<< endl;
	return 0;
}
